validation.scoreValidation: All 233 lower/upper/resolved outputs independently recalculated from effective core states and match workbook caches within 1e-8.

scope: Merge two inventories and apply the v4 Word rubric to documentation evidence. Unit: one identified dataset/release record, not one hosted URL or one independent acquisition corpus.
limitations: Ten candidates and the CAMBER Video 1 scope check have fresh primary-documentation assessments. CrackBlock also has a fresh D4 check. Other assessments reinterpret the source workbooks evidence snapshots. All are AI provisional; no payload inspection, independent human rating or successful retrieval is claimed. Each core decision has a source, locator, summary and rationale.

relationships.Reason: CiCS, LEiS and CrackBlock600k share author/acquisition lineage, but different named archives and representations. A common repository does not establish duplicate release identity.
CRACK500 and GAPs384 use a shared benchmark repository but different acquisition corpora.
CrackLS315, CrackTree260 and CRKWH100 are distinct named benchmarks in a shared repository.
Different DOI deposits and annotation tasks; retain separate task-specific releases.
RDD2018, 2019, 2020 and 2022 share lineage but differ by release. Never sum their counts as independent imagery.
Re-labeling, filtering, severity, pseudo-label and compiled releases have different targets; preserve relation and audit leakage before cross-dataset evaluation.
CoCG axis-aligned detection and oriented boxes are distinct annotation releases, not independent footage.
CRACK500 noisy masks are a distinct annotation study release with shared underlying images.
CrackSeg9k and CombinedCrack aggregate earlier crack corpora. Keep compiled release identities, flag shared ancestry for train/test audits.
701-image RTK segmentation is distinct from larger RTK raw sequences / surface-quality classification; overlapping collection and different labels.
GAPs384 crack masks, GAPs10m semantic segmentation and GAPsv2 classification/detection are different release scopes. Shared imagery lineage must not be treated as independent.

Pothole-600 official site links its Kaggle mirror, while 2019 Stereo Pothole Datasets have separate paper and packaging. Pothole Mix compiles published sources plus new clips. Exact cross-release frame overlap unverified.
Different Roboflow project identifiers and annotation export scopes. Do not merge based on the generic pothole segmentation name.
Both may trace to MakeML, but DS138 adds size categories/splits. No verified identical release manifest; retain separate and audit image hashes before independence claims.
Both cite South African pothole imagery; classification challenge and bounding-box packaging differ. Exact overlap unverified; retain separate.
Matching generic 3-class descriptions/resolution are insufficient provenance proof. Keep separate, high-priority ancestry follow-up.
UAV-SEG/Enhanced UAV-PDD is a derived annotation release. Legacy DS175 preferred parent Zenodo URL is insufficient to identify derivative; use its Kaggle record and verify access.

relationships.Relationship: Shared capture family; distinct NATIX subsets
relationships.Reason: Edge-case, multi-camera and safety-critical packages are different released subsets; shared Tesla capture ecosystem is not proof of all clips duplicating. Check trip/frame IDs before combined use.
RSRD-seg is a small labeled subset of RSRD; separate modalities/task labels. Shared download portal is not duplicate identity.
RoadSaW wetness/material and RoadSC snow cover use complementary label definitions, not aliases.
Argoverse1, Argoverse2 Sensor and Map Change serve different release scopes. AV2 Map Change may reuse Sensor frames; record exact overlap before pooled evaluation.
KITTI Raw and KITTI-360 are separate data acquisitions. Preserve named-release boundary.
nuImages, nuPlan sensor release and nuScenes have distinct published scope; brand/platform sharing does not merge dataset identity.
End-to-End Driving and Perception releases use separate release formats and target annotations; common download portal not duplicate proof.
Vistas, StreetSurfaceVis and global-potholes use Mapillary-related imagery but different selected records/annotations. Shared provider is not sufficient for deduplication; inspect image IDs.

top10Review.Why selected: Compact class-folder example; checks whether pavement crops are distinguished from walls/decks and original captures.
top10Review.First manual action: Open USU Methodology and ReadMe; identify pavement C/U folders; then inspect one cracked and one uncracked crop.
top10Review.Release / scope: USU SDNET2018 deposit, 2018; pavement subset within full release
top10Review.Known limitation: Whole-deposit count is not pavement-only count; related crops are not independent images. No payload inspection.

top10Review.Why selected: Small original corpus with clear original-image/crop distinction; useful calibration for sampling and ancestry.
top10Review.First manual action: Read paper IV-B1; verify 500 original images versus 3,368 retained crops and map one image to its binary mask.
top10Review.Release / scope: FPHBN documented CRACK500 split, 2019 paper / author repository
top10Review.Known limitation: Repository bundles other datasets. Do not count companion corpora as CRACK500. Data terms and label QA remain unresolved.

top10Review.Why selected: Well-documented detection exemplar with country subsets, label map and download manifest.
top10Review.First manual action: Open label_map.pbtxt and directory structure; inspect one public training XML; note test annotations are withheld.
top10Review.Known limitation: Contains earlier RDD lineage. Country folders do not prove route-independent splits; third-party rights require separate reuse check.

top10Review.Why selected: Meeting-critical example; public task tree makes differences among classification, detection, masks and VQA easy to check.
top10Review.First manual action: Compare six classification categories with merged detection/segmentation classes; inspect label_map.txt and one QA record.
top10Review.Release / scope: Hugging Face MML-Group/PaveBench, current card snapshot 2026-10-11
top10Review.Known limitation: Documentation-only pass does not validate mask accuracy, physical metrology, benchmark independence or maintenance outcomes.

top10Review.Why selected: Deliberate derivative exemplar exposes parent overlap, annotation transformations and changed release counts.
top10Review.First manual action: Open author README V4 instructions; reconcile approximately 9,160 current images with 9,255 in the paper; inspect parent prefixes.
top10Review.Release / scope: Author-recommended Dataverse V4, June 2024; release content requires reconciliation
top10Review.Known limitation: Shares parents with SDNET2018 and CRACK500 in this shortlist. Not an independent external test. V4 payload not inspected.

top10Review.Why selected: Stable DOI and compact data paper provide an accessible UAV example with concrete label-overlay verification.
top10Review.First manual action: Open paper Figures 2–3 and XML example; verify six class codes, 2,440 images and one image-label overlay.
top10Review.Known limitation: Images include crops and augmentation. Random splits do not establish original-frame independence; route groups remain unverified.

top10Review.Why selected: Manageable multimodal exemplar with 600 paired items and a clear source site; useful contrast between imagery and metrology.
top10Review.First manual action: Follow official Dataset page to Drive/Kaggle; match one RGB image, transformed disparity and mask; confirm data terms.
top10Review.Release / scope: Author Pothole-600 release accompanying ECCV Workshops 2020
top10Review.Known limitation: Distinguish from separate 2019 Stereo Pothole Datasets. Transformation is not calibrated pothole depth; license/QA/location remain unresolved.

top10Review.Why selected: Nine-run example makes non-image units, sensor rates and category-versus-measured-IRI distinction practical to review.
top10Review.First manual action: Read sensor and run tables; check one dataset_labels.csv with its GPS record and environmental-video timestamp.
top10Review.Release / scope: Nine-run PVS family; author README snapshot 2026-10-11
top10Review.Known limitation: Three vehicle/driver pairs are confounded. Roughness classes are not measured IRI. Missing codes, label QA and terms scope need confirmation.

top10Review.Why selected: Essential engineering contrast; manual pilot can focus on one section and measurement table rather than the entire database.
top10Review.First manual action: Confirm SDR selection, open LTPPDD and MON_DIS_AC_REV definitions, then inspect one section/date with null-versus-zero handling.
top10Review.Release / scope: SDR39 context retained from v4; current portal identifies SDR40 as latest; selection pending
top10Review.Known limitation: Release-specific counts/distributions and schema continuity remain pending; 2021 guide is context, not proof of SDR39/40 completeness.

top10Review.Representation: AV fleet road wetness and snow classification
top10Review.Why selected: New AV-inventory exemplar with public samples, concise surface-label definitions and an SDK mini-download option.
top10Review.First manual action: Open Annotations → Road surface and Frames samples; verify wetness/snow labels in one Frame; check access route before retrieval.
top10Review.Release / scope: ZOD Frames public documentation snapshot 2026-10-11; distinguish Sequences/Drives
top10Review.Known limitation: Surface labels apply to Frames; do not infer labels on every video frame or autonomous engagement. Not crack/PCI ground truth.
